claims: The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal is also known as Huntrix.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal is a limited-time adult Happy Meal.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal was launched on March 31, 2026.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal is inspired by the KPop Demon Hunters Netflix film.
The HUNTR/X Meal includes 10-piece Chicken McNuggets.
The HUNTR/X Meal includes Ramyeon McShaker Fries.
Ramyeon McShaker Fries come with a separate bag and soy, garlic, sesame, and spice seasoning to shake.
The HUNTR/X Meal includes a medium soft drink.
The HUNTR/X Meal includes Demon Sauce.
Demon Sauce is purple-colored savory mustard.
The HUNTR/X Meal includes Hunter Sauce.
Hunter Sauce is a sweet chili mix.
The HUNTR/X Meal is part of the KPop Demon Hunters collaboration.
The KPop Demon Hunters collaboration features a Saja Boys breakfast meal.
The KPop Demon Hunters collaboration features a Derpy the Tiger McFlurry
